description: Try the FIRST complement CholeskyQR2 (the n=512 low-rank complement build, ~line 2479) at 1 pass instead of 2, mirroring the range-finders justified 1-pass. brief-62 measured the CQR2 batch_trsm_left solve is the biggest genuine outer cost on shapes 3 (16.6 percent) and 8 (14.9 percent); dropping the 2nd pass removes a whole Gram+Cholesky+trsm per complement build. brief-65 (first-complement-CQR2 pass count) explored across 3 trials + 5-reseed fallback diagnostics + before/after nsys on shape8. MEASURED FINDING: 1-pass is a NET LOSS on every low-rank shape -- it tips the per-matrix gate into materially more cuSOLVER fallback, erasing (far exceeding) the trsm saving. GLOBAL 1-pass (t1 a4a15ee9): geomean 29498->38373us (+30%), fallback shape3 0.09->6.66%, shape4 0.33->19.00%, shape6 0.00->5.19%, shape8 0.50->2.56%, shape12 0.00->22.67%. SHAPE-8-ONLY 1-pass (t3 2acc12c6, the least-bad route): shape8 89008->109941 (+23.5%), geomean 30040 (+1.9%); nsys shape8 batch_trsm_left 26->24 instances (saved 0.97ms trsm) but sytrd4_cta cuSOLVER fallback 0.315->7.28ms (+6.96ms). Gram precision does NOT help (3xtf32 first-pass ~same fallback); tighter shift (1e-6) crashes Cholesky; DROPPING the first CQR entirely = 100% fallback (worst_orth ~13-17) -> the project-CQR2-project-CQR2 unit is irreducible. SAFE HOOK LEFT AT t2 (b4617e9f): parametrized _lr_compl_cqr1_passes_for (default 2, parent-equivalent, geomean 29486, 39/39 PASS, 0 fallback increase, shape6 clean) -- adds the 1-pass infrastructure without regressing, for any future conditioning-gated attempt. shape6 mixed-peel stayed clean at 2-pass (0.00% fallback). OPEN DIRECTIONS (manager's call): (1) the CQR2 batch_trsm_left is still the biggest genuine outer cost (12.1-14.9% shapes 3/8, 24-26 trsm launches/repeat) -- but the lever is NOT pass-count; a batched/blocked trsm or fusing the two complement CQR2s' trsms, or replacing solve_triangular with an explicit R^-1 multiply (triangular-inverse then GEMM on tensor cores) could cut trsm wall without touching pass count. (2) shape8 rankdef512 has a persistent ~0.5% (16-mat) 2-pass fallback tail with worst_orth 4.75 -- a pre-existing per-matrix outlier that always cuSOLVERs; a k bump or targeted re-orth on those could reclaim ~16 cuSOLVER calls independent of this brief. (3) per-matrix-conditioning-gated 1-pass would need a pre-CQR conditioning probe whose own Gram cost likely negates the trsm saving -- unmeasured. NOT stream-tainted anywhere.
